From the Publisher

The Moleskine Classic notebooks have pages just waiting to be filled with your notes and ideas. Rounded corners, ivory-colored pages, elastic closure for privacy and a bookmark ribbon – so you never lose track of the direction your thoughts are taking.

Take notes, write to-do lists and capture thoughts on ivory-colored pages inspired by the original legendary notebook.

A legendary collection in a variety of colors and layouts. Choose from ruled, plain, dotted and squared notebooks to best suit your note-taking needs.

Classic design features include an elastic closure for privacy and a ribbon bookmark so you never lose track of where you are. The expandable back pocket makes room for notes, cards and mementos gathered along the way.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find this journal perfect for sermon notes and appreciate its ease of writing, with one noting it works well with fountain pens. The notebook receives positive feedback for its classic design, flexibility, and versatility, with one customer highlighting its suitability for both studio and field use. While some customers report no significant bleed-through, others mention ink bleeding through pages, and several note the pages are very thin.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
This is a Moleskin Household!
I love Moleskin notebooks. The leather is always good quality, the spine stays strong for years. The lines are helpful for writing, but light enough they won't really show in a doodle or sketch. Great value for what it costs. These notebooks are always high quality, clean. Lends for a real professional look. The elastic strap to keep it closed has held up for 7 years on my last notebook, far longer than most. Even the paper has a nice quality and weight to it. If you've never had one, try it. You'll never go back.
